lines.zh: 羽冠在风里晃，我走得很直。
lines.en: My crest sways in the wind; I walk straight.

lines.zh: 短剑挂在右胯，盾在左手。
lines.en: Short sword at my right hip, shield on my left.

lines.zh: 沿着营地的木栅走一圈。
lines.en: I circle the camp's wooden palisade.
A hundred follow me and stay in order.

lines.zh: 靴底踩过石板，声音整齐。
lines.en: Studs click on stone, all in step.

lines.zh: 我走在最前面，替他们看路。
lines.en: I walk in front to scout their path.
The Roman standard is behind me.

lines.zh: 红披风拖过后面的尘土。
lines.en: My red cloak drags through the dust behind.
My stride is steady from long drill.

lines.zh: 每走过一面盾，就敲一下。
lines.en: I tap each shield as I pass.

lines.zh: 要慢就全队慢，要快就全队快。
lines.en: Slow together, or fast together.

lines.zh: 腰上系着百夫长的带子。
lines.en: The centurion's belt is at my waist.

lines.zh: 穿过营地，去看西面的缺口。
lines.en: Through camp to check the west gap.
My feet are callused from marching.
Standing, studying the scratches on my shield.

lines.zh: 羽冠被风吹偏了，我扶正。
lines.en: The crest blew askew; I set it straight.
My back is straighter than a standard pole.
Listening to the anvils in camp.
I am thinking about formation spacing.
A soldier slacks off; I look at him.
Rain in the air. The armor needs oil.
I count the tents: twenty.

lines.zh: 这个营地太小，展不开队。
lines.en: This camp is too tight to deploy.
I stand here waiting for orders.
Too long in the sun. My eyelids droop.
I stay standing; it looks better.
I think of Rome's stone roads.
Give your name and unit.
Stand properly. Heels together.
Your back will not straighten, recruit.
This is a Roman camp.
I look at a man's feet first.
Do not hide your hands in your cloak.
To join, first learn to march.
Your boots are out of regulation.

lines.zh: 我手下有一百人，不差你一个。
lines.en: I have a hundred men. I do not need you.
Eyes on me. Stop glancing about.
Be clear. Where did you come from?
One word from me moves the whole unit.
Do not draw a blade in front of me.
Broad shoulders. You could carry the standard.
I credit merit, not talk.
Three steps back. Stand beyond the line.
Cut down, and I give half a step.
Not serious. The line matters more.
Blood seeps through my cloak.
A crack runs through my bracer.
It hurts, but I cannot cry out.
Steady my feet, then steady the men.
This wound goes in the report.
Teeth clenched, sword back to my chest.

lines.zh: 手下的人在看，我不能倒。
lines.en: My men are watching. I cannot fall.
Left shoulder. I can still grip.
Good hide would make a fine cloak.
That short sword is well made.
A new pair of greaves would be welcome.
March rations are always one bite short.
Wine would lift the men's spirits.
This shield is lighter than mine.
Do not eat hot food in front of the ranks.
My crest needs replacing.
I respect a smith's craft.
The smell of roast stops my feet.

lines.zh: 撞我一下，等于撞了队旗。
lines.en: Bumping me is bumping the standard.
Back off. The formation must not break.
Your pauldron is sharp.
Move. I must inspect the line.
Steady. Do not step on my cloak.
Bump me, fine. Leave the shield alone.
That knocked the whole file crooked.
I never yield the road. Go around.
Iron on iron should sound in rhythm.
Stand off. I am losing count.
My betrothal is back in Rome.
A centurion brings no family to camp.
Camp is no place for such talk.
After discharge, back in the city.
The unit comes before private matters.

lines.zh: 我的披风还没换成婚礼的。
lines.en: My cloak is not yet a wedding one.
I must ask my commander first.
The men are watching. It is not fitting.
I set that thought aside.
Army on my back, home in my heart.
Whose copper coin is this?

lines.zh: 捡起掉在地上的皮带扣。
lines.en: I pick up a dropped belt buckle.
No clutter in camp.
I bend, and my cloak sweeps the dirt.
The arrowhead is straight. It can be reused.
It goes to the quartermaster's ledger.
This is not mine. Do not guess.
I lift a fallen standard.
I roll up the rope on the ground.
Into the bag now, roll call after.
Unit, attention. Front right.
Shields up. Whole unit, form a line.
Target confirmed. Advance.
I step out first. The unit follows.
That one will not yield. We will teach him.
Short swords out. Keep the formation.
You take the left. The right is mine.
Push him to the wall.
My shield moves first, and the men follow.
Remember: this is an order.
Press in step by step. No rush.
He is hunting a gap. I watch for it.
Shield forward, sword behind the elbow.
The standard is on my left.
I do not shout; shouting breaks order.
Wait for the encircling to close.
This one has some discipline.
I slide my foot a half inch forward.
The order is simple: no retreat.
The shield shoves and the short sword stabs.
A thrust at his weapon hand.

lines.zh: 贴上去，别给他挥剑的余地。
lines.en: Close in; give him no room to swing.
The short blade is half a beat quicker.
The line braces on both flanks.
This thrust has been drilled a thousand times.
The shield rim clips his jaw.
Recover. Then the second thrust.
I do not chase glory; I need him down.
The whole unit, one step, one strike.
Centurion reporting. Form the ranks.
I came straight from the march.
The crest arrives before the man.
Roll call, starting with the first file.
Who commands this camp? Report.
I come with written orders.
Rain from the road is still on my cloak.
A hundred lives are on me.
Standard up, men aligned.
Begin the equipment check.
My cloak is burning. Put it out.
My greave hits first.
Water pours in through the breathing holes.

lines.zh: 土盖了我一身，队伍没散。
lines.en: Dirt covers me, but the line holds.
A javelin is stuck in my shield.

lines.zh: 这东西不是军阵能挡的。
lines.en: No formation stops this.
The supply cart is late. We all endure.

lines.zh: 闪电打在羽冠上，头发焦了。
lines.en: Lightning hits my crest; my hair is singed.
The road is swallowed under me.
